issues.location: conditional rule labels in prose, lines 90 and 100
issues.finding: The two prose rule labels pass lif before the sign, reversing the sign/connective argument order used by the correct rule table.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use TRule{True}{lif} and TRule{False}{lif} in the prose descriptions.

issues.location: two branch descriptions for true implication, including the current-prefix specialization
issues.finding: The prose gives a true antecedent or false consequent for a true implication, whereas the correctly printed table branches to a false antecedent or true consequent. The incorrect signs occur both at the used extension and at the current prefix.
issues.proposed_resolution: Use False A and True B on separate branches in both prose instances, matching the existing table.

issues.location: parenthetical statement about the conjunction truth world
issues.finding: The phrase and not at any other world incorrectly excludes truth elsewhere; intuitionistic truth persists at accessible worlds. The intended point is that this rule introduces its conclusions at the same prefix.
issues.proposed_resolution: Explain that the rule introduces formulas at the current prefix without excluding their truth at other worlds.
